analysis: The bundled numeric-key hash first converts small integer keys to doubles, XORs the double words and multiplies by 3163. Masking low bits for these power-of-two tables puts sequential small integers in one bucket. The constant per-context seed/tag XOR permutes bucket numbers without changing these occupancies. map_find_record scans a bucket chain and checks SameValueZero.
limits: Derived from the exact locally compiled rquickjs-sys 0.14.0 source; no QuickJS source patch was made.
This explains a key-distribution sensitivity, not every observed timing or a universal ranking.
String and object fixtures remain necessary controls; numeric-only relative gains can overstate performance against other key distributions.
